theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_mollification_gradient
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∀ (ρ : Rn n → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ → (∀ z, ε ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z • (ball (0 : Rn n) 1).indicator f (x - z)) ∧ ∀ x : Rn n, ‖x‖ < 1 - ε → gradient (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z • (ball (0 : Rn n) 1).indicator f (x - z)) x = ∫ z, ρ z • (ball (0 : Rn n) 1).indicator g (x - z)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
